name: Sogolytics
description_en:
Sogolytics is an experience-management vendor spanning enterprise surveys, customer experience, employee experience and managed research. SogoCore is the enterprise survey offering; SogoCX and SogoEX organize customer and employee programmes. The current site also directs smaller questionnaire projects toward a separate low-cost offer.

The practical selection question is whether you need a survey project, a continuous experience programme or researchers to perform work for you. These share a vendor but have different commercial bases, administration and service scope. This profile concentrates on the enterprise family without importing old low-cost plan amounts.
description_zh:
Sogolytics 覆盖企业问卷、客户体验、员工体验及托管研究。SogoCore 是企业问卷产品，SogoCX 和 SogoEX 分别组织客户及员工体验项目，现行网站还把小型问卷需求引向单独低成本方案。

选型需先明确要的是一份问卷、持续体验项目，还是由研究人员代为执行。它们虽同属一个厂商，但商业计费、管理及服务范围不同。本文聚焦企业产品家族，不沿用旧低成本套餐金额。

core_features.explanation_en: Build from templates or scratch with branching and piping.
core_features.explanation_zh: 从模板或空白创建，配置分支与答案引用。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect reporting, ownership and integrations within the contracted programme.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在约定项目范围内连接报表、负责人和集成。

en: Route a post-delivery survey response to an accountable follow-up owner.
zh: 把交付后问卷反馈交给明确负责人跟进。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose the product and account scope, create from scratch/copy/template, then configure distribution and the action owner.
steps.zh: 选择产品与账户范围，从空白、复制或模板创建，再配置分发与行动负责人。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom enterprise quote by product, response/admin capacity or employees and services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Enterprise products require a quote. Survey pricing considers responses and admins; CX also consulting; EX employee count. Managed research/services are optional additions. No standard amount or free production entitlement was verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 企业产品需询价。问卷考虑回答与管理员数，CX 还涉及咨询，EX 按员工人数；托管研究和服务为可选增加项。本次未核实标准金额或免费生产权益。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Select the right member of the product family
sections.title_zh: 先选产品家族中的具体成员
sections.en: SogoCore covers enterprise survey creation, distribution, dashboards and data operations. SogoCX adds customer journeys and customer-feedback programmes; SogoEX focuses on employee lifecycle and engagement. Managed research provides human project services. A feature demonstrated for one programme should not automatically be assigned to all accounts.
sections.zh: SogoCore 覆盖企业问卷创建、分发、仪表盘及数据操作；SogoCX 延伸客户旅程和客户反馈项目，SogoEX 侧重员工生命周期与敬业度，托管研究则提供人工项目服务。某一项目的演示功能不能自动归入所有账户。

sections.title_en: Create a project before designing the operational handoff
sections.title_zh: 先创建项目，再设计业务交接
sections.en: The help guide offers starting from scratch, copying a project or using a template bank. Available project types depend on the account. The enterprise survey page then describes logic, multiple distribution channels, analysis and routing to business systems. For an illustrative post-delivery survey, preserve the order context and define who receives a negative response. Verify the actual integration and permissions before assuming a generated action plan creates a usable case.
sections.zh: 帮助文档提供空白创建、复制项目和模板库，项目类型随账户而定。企业问卷页进一步说明逻辑、多渠道分发、分析及向业务系统分发。例如交付后问卷，应保留订单上下文并明确负面回答由谁接收。不能假定生成行动计划就创建了可处理案件，应先核对真实集成和权限。

sections.title_en: Request a quote against the actual programme
sections.en: The enterprise pricing page gives no standard purchase amount. Advanced survey pricing depends on responses and administrator users; customer experience also considers consulting services, and employee experience is based on employee count. Managed services are optional add-ons. Therefore a free template, student license or download does not establish a free enterprise deployment. Ask for channel limits, integration scope, admins, implementation and ongoing service in one quote.
sections.zh: 企业定价页未给标准购买金额。高级问卷按回答与管理员人数计费，客户体验还考虑咨询服务，员工体验按员工数计费。托管服务是可选附加项。因此，免费模板、学生许可或下载不证明企业部署免费。询价时应一并说明渠道上限、集成范围、管理员、实施及持续服务。

sections.en: AI sentiment, theme detection and dashboards can organize incoming answers, but neither a label nor a key-driver chart establishes causation. Compare the original response with classification, the destination owner and resulting action. The homepage’s customer examples and projected improvements were not independently reproduced. Permissions, anonymity claims and security controls require the intended configuration and contract, especially for employee programmes.
sections.zh: AI 情绪、主题检测和仪表盘帮助整理回答，但标签或驱动因素图不能证明因果。应比较原始回答、分类、目标负责人及实际行动。本文未独立复现首页客户案例或预计改善。权限、匿名主张及安全控制需核对配置与合同，员工项目尤其如此。

sections.title_en: Plan for a hosted programme and its owner
sections.title_zh: 为托管项目与负责人安排条件
sections.en: Sogolytics merits investigation when multiple teams need governed feedback programmes and follow-up, rather than only a public poll link. No self-hosted distribution or source-code license was verified. Exact retry handling, export completeness, residency and retention remain untested. Small projects should evaluate the separately described low-cost solution instead of treating enterprise capabilities as its default entitlement.
sections.zh: 多个团队需要受管理的反馈及后续行动时，可以研究 Sogolytics，而不仅是公开投票链接。本次未确认自托管发行版或源码许可，重试、导出完整性、存储地区及保留仍未实测。小项目应评估独立低成本方案，不能把企业能力当成默认权益。

research_gaps: No account, distribution, integration, AI analysis, anonymity control or case workflow was tested.
Enterprise quote, low-cost product entitlements, storage/retention terms, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
